trust_decision.summary: Whether an element's character data may be echoed without encoding is decided only by the tag flag check in Rules::shallAllowInsecureRawText(), which trusts the raw-text boundaries the parser produced; the parser leaves whitespace-form end tags and noscript-nested raw text inside the element, so the check approves text that the browser will tokenize as live markup.

landing_point.why: The advisory/fix title names ALLOW_INSECURE_RAW_TEXT, whose only consumer is shallAllowInsecureRawText(); an engineer greps the flag (defined at src/Behavior/Tag.php:48, used in tests/ScenarioTest.php:455-463) and lands on the serializer gate, not on the tokenizer.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The tokenizer that mis-parses </style\t> is third-party code (composer.json:19 requires masterminds/html5 ^2.7.6), so the end-tag handling is an upstream parse bug and the local fix belongs in the serializer that echoes the text; and the whole-document parse() method the fix also overrides has no caller inside the package, so overriding only parseFragment() looks sufficient.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: ALLOW_INSECURE_RAW_TEXT must keep working for declared tags: <script type="application/ld+json"> bodies and <iframe>/<style> raw content are emitted unencoded by design, so an over-broad fix that encodes all raw-text output in Rules::element()/text() breaks the JSON-LD script feature and the iframe raw-text expectation.

O6_input_shapes: raw-text end tag with whitespace before '>' (</style\t>) instead of the exact </style> the old tokenizer searched for (fix.diff:249-258)
a raw-text element nested inside <noscript>, where the browser's raw-text mode for noscript (scripting on/off) re-delimits the output (fix.diff:271-280)
the same payloads under both the default encoding behaviour and an ALLOW_INSECURE_RAW_TEXT behaviour (fix.diff:250-258), i.e. the shape pair decides whether the payload is loud or silent

O7_producer.where: The DOM text nodes that Rules writes raw are produced one layer earlier by the parser (src/Sanitizer.php:95-98 -> parseFragment()) and consumed at serialization (src/Sanitizer.php:112-116); the gate at src/Serializer/Rules.php:198-205 inspects only the tag flag and never re-checks how the text was delimited by the tokenizer.

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: svg/math are already special-cased at src/Serializer/Rules.php:126-128 and the advisory is explicitly about noscript and whitespace end tags, so ALLOW_INSECURE_RAW_TEXT inside SVG reads as an unsupported combination rather than part of the same protection.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Callers that build the DOM with their own Masterminds\HTML5 and serialize through the public Serializer\Rules API (Rules::create()/traverse()) still get the whitespace end-tag bypass, because the tokenizer substitution lives only in the protected Sanitizer::createParser(); the noscript half of the fix applies to Rules but the parse half does not.
O8_uncovered_routes.where: src/Serializer/Rules.php:59-65,98-105 (public factory + traverse on a caller-supplied DOM), src/Sanitizer.php:199-202 (protected factory, the only place the fixed parser is installed)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Rules is only the output side; the caller owns parsing, so the package cannot be blamed for a DOM built by someone else's parser and the advisory is about Sanitizer::sanitize().
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 0 files from the landing point (src/Serializer/Rules.php) but one layer away in src/Sanitizer.php:199-202, which is protected and therefore not reachable by a composing caller

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second context rule beside the noscript one, denying ALLOW_INSECURE_RAW_TEXT for raw-text elements under svg/math (or under any non-HTML integration-point ancestor)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix itself establishes the pattern 'a raw-text element in context X is denied'; a maintainer following up on foreign-content mXSS would add exactly one more hasAncestorWithName() call here, and the svg/math special case three lines above (Rules.php:126-128) shows the file already reasons about foreign content.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A raw-text element set that differs from Elements::TEXT_RAW (e.g. treating noscript or plaintext as raw text only in the contexts where browsers do)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: isRawText() is the single name-based oracle the whole gate depends on; adding or narrowing one element here changes the behaviour of every raw-text element and is the natural place for a maintainer to chase the next parser differential.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second serialization route via Masterminds' own saveHTML() (also used at src/Behavior/Handler/AsTextHandler.php:31) that would need the same encoding/context rules applied
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: convertToText() already stringifies a node with the vendor serializer and stores the markup as a text node; if that node lands in a raw-text parent, Rules writes it back out unencoded, so a maintainer hardening raw text would naturally have to route this path through the same decision.

O9_family: mutation XSS / parser differential on raw-text (RAWTEXT) delimitation (CWE-79)
